## Highlights since 0.19.3

- **Jump between Typst source and PDF.** In the native Lattice, double-click a place in a Typst document's PDF to put the cursor on that line of its source, even in a file you `#include`, or press ⌘⇧J (Jump to PDF) to mark the cursor's line in the PDF. Edits you haven't saved count too. Lattice downloads the matching Typst support once more after this update.
- **Word wrap in the Agent's diffs.** Long lines in the Agent's diffs now wrap, in both versions of Lattice. The wrap button in the diff's toolbar, Word wrap in its … menu, or ⌥Z turns wrapping off and on again, and Lattice remembers your choice.

## Notable fixes

- Holding a shortcut such as ⌘K or ⌘W runs its command once, in both versions of Lattice: the command palette no longer flickers open and shut, and a held ⌘W no longer closes one tab after another (#1233).
- In the Agent, + › Files and folders attaches the file you pick again (#1253).
- In the native Lattice, New folder in the Project panel makes a folder instead of a file, and empty folders show as folders.
- In the native Lattice, New file or New folder inside a closed folder opens the folder, scrolls to the new entry and puts the cursor in its name.
- In the native Lattice, the build button shows how long you waited for the build, so Typst builds no longer read 0.0 s.
- In the native Lattice, closing a pane's last tab closes the pane instead of leaving an empty one behind.
